name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a rule — whenever the siren starts ringing, the agent must turn it off — which is exactly the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled). The siren ring is a condition the agent must answer with a switch toggle, not a commanded event, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid here. The machine pays for letting the siren ring untoggled and rewards the toggle that closes the obligation, matching the clause.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
